evidence: Ruff 0.16.9 reports ASYNC221 on `os.spawnl(m, "x")` where `m` is bound by `with os.P_WAIT as m:`: is_p_wait (crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_async/rules/blocking_process_invocation.rs:176) reads a name's value through find_assigned_value, and find_binding_value (crates/ruff_python_semantic/src/analyze/typing.rs:1273) takes a with-item binding's value. The ports' shared `p-wait-arg` utility has no with-item case, so ASYNC221 misses the call and the ASYNC220 candidate reports it instead. Fix both together (NER-1770), then drop this entry.
